noteTitle: CIS 224 Midterm · CPU Performance, Pipeline & Prediction
title: UNIT 1 — FOUNDATIONS
markdown:
#### UNIT 1 — FOUNDATIONS

01 Clock Rate / Period〔考纲〕｜把 GHz 当执行时间 → T=1/f；2 GHz 对应 0.5 ns/cycle

02 Total Cycles / CPU Time〔A2〕｜只问 Cycles 却乘秒 → Cycles=IC×CPI；Time=Cycles×T

03 Instruction Mix〔A2〕｜对各类 CPI 直接求平均 → Average CPI=Σ(比例×该类 CPI)

04 Speedup〔A2〕｜只看 GHz 或比值颠倒 → 先分别求 Time；慢时间÷快时间

05 Latency / Throughput / Bandwidth〔考纲〕｜把单次时间、完成速率、传输上限混淆 → Latency=单次耗时；Throughput=任务数/时间；Bandwidth=最大数据传输率
